en.headline: Nearly one in three unattended dogs captured this year euthanised
en.dek: The Environment and Ecology Bureau told lawmakers the proportion has risen from 18 per cent in 2021, with 617 dogs euthanised between 2021 and May.
body: Roughly one in three unattended dogs captured by authorities had been euthanised as of May this year, a sharp increase from 18 per cent in 2021, according to a written response from the Environment and Ecology Bureau to the Legislative Council.

Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said a total of 617 unattended dogs were euthanised between 2021 and May this year. The proportion of captured dogs later reclaimed by owners or transferred to animal welfare groups for rehoming has also fallen over the past five years.

The figures come as the government continues a review of dog control regulations following a series of attacks. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department has stepped up capture operations at high-risk locations and has said it will not release unclaimed dogs back into the community for public safety reasons.

zh.headline: 今年捕獲的流浪狗近三分之一被人道毀滅
zh.dek: 環境及生態局回覆立法會，比例由2021年的18%大幅上升，2021年至5月共有617隻狗被人道毀滅。
body: 根據環境及生態局向立法會提交的書面回覆，截至今年5月，當局捕獲的流浪狗約有三分之一被人道毀滅，較2021年的18%大幅上升。
環境及生態局局長謝展寰表示，2021年至今年5月期間，共有617隻流浪狗被人道毀滅。過去五年，被捕獲狗隻其後由主人領回或轉介動物福利團體領養的比例亦有下降。
有關數字公布之際，政府正因應多宗狗隻襲擊事件檢討管束狗隻的法規。漁農自然護理署已加強在高風險地點的捕捉行動，並強調為保障公眾安全，不會將無人認領的狗隻放回社區。
